The best advice I ever got came from a plumber.

He was fixing a leak under my sink while I complained about a client who kept moving the deadline.

He said: you do not fix a leak by arguing with the water.

I fired the client the next morning. Revenue dropped eleven percent that quarter and my sleep improved by roughly the same amount.

Every year since, when a project starts to drip, I think about the water.
